transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Ever since they changed my position at the shop, I just can’t seem to adjust, and it’s throwing off my work and my whole routine. I'm just really struggling to get used to the new setup and wanted to see what I can do to get back on track.
Since this change occurred, have you been feeling mostly down and tearful, or are you experiencing more nervousness, worry, and tension?

To be honest, it’s really a mix of both. I feel completely defeated and on the verge of tears, but I’m also incredibly wound up and filled with dread about going into work. It just feels like I'm constantly tense and sad at the same time.
How long ago did this change in your position at work occur, and have you noticed any other major changes in your life during this same period?

The change happened about a month ago, and while there haven't been any other major life events, it has completely wrecked my personal life. I've stopped doing my metal sculpting commissions and hobbies like paddle-boarding, and the stress is really straining my relationship with my spouse. It just feels like this one work change has disrupted absolutely everything.
When you think about your daily struggles, do you feel that the feelings of sadness and hopelessness are more prominent, or are the feelings of nervousness and worry more dominant?

It really feels like a difficult mix of both, and I can't easily separate them. On the anxious side, I'm constantly wound up, snapping at people, and filled with dread about meeting these tight quotas. At the same time, I feel so defeated and on the verge of tears that I just don't have the energy to work on my sculptures anymore.
